title: A Codex session's Engram MCP call stays pending for minutes after a TermAl restart while the same read via the CLI returns in under 1 s
outcome: An Engram MCP tool call from a Codex root session either returns or fails with a typed, visible timeout within the configured tool timeout. It never stays pending indefinitely while the Engram store and CLI are healthy, including in the first minutes after a TermAl restart.
acceptance: A Codex session's Engram MCP call stays pending for minutes after a TermAl restart while the same read via the CLI returns in under 1 s is done
